evals.prompt: Find my recent diary entries from this week and summarize what I wrote about.
evals.expected_output: Uses the specific iCloud vault path to find diary entries, reads from the Diary/ subfolder with date-formatted filenames (MM-DD-YYYY.md), and returns actual content.

assertions.name: uses-icloud-vault-path
assertions.description: Uses the exact vault path: /Users/example/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/personal — NOT a generic ~/Documents or ~/Obsidian path

assertions.name: targets-diary-subfolder
assertions.description: Looks in the Diary/ subfolder specifically, not searching the entire vault root

assertions.name: uses-date-format-MM-DD-YYYY
assertions.description: Searches for or references files with MM-DD-YYYY.md naming pattern (the vault's diary format)

evals.prompt: Add a new note to my Obsidian vault about a project idea: build a CLI tool that converts voice memos to structured meeting notes. Put it with my other Golems ideas.
evals.expected_output: Creates or appends to a file in the Golems/ subfolder of the iCloud vault. Preserves existing content if the file exists. Does not delete any notes.

assertions.name: writes-to-golems-subfolder
assertions.description: Creates/updates a file inside the Golems/ subfolder of the vault, not in vault root or another folder

assertions.name: does-not-delete-existing-notes
assertions.description: If modifying an existing file (like Golems Ideas.md), reads it first before writing to preserve existing content

evals.prompt: Search my Obsidian notes for anything mentioning 'authentication' or 'auth flow'.
evals.expected_output: Searches across the vault using the correct iCloud path, searching .md files for the terms, and returns matching note paths with context.

assertions.name: searches-vault-not-filesystem
assertions.description: Searches within the iCloud Obsidian vault path, not in ~/Gits/ or other code directories

assertions.name: searches-md-files-only
assertions.description: Restricts search to .md files (--include='*.md' or equivalent), not all file types

assertions.name: returns-file-paths-with-context
assertions.description: Shows which note files matched, not just a yes/no answer
